name: comp-457
title: Compact Page Pagination
description: A small pagination footer that states the current page and total between left and right chevron links, with no numbered pages.
use: A compact list or table footer where a full numbered pager would be too heavy.
avoid: When people need to skip several pages: the control only steps one page at a time.
a11y: Each chevron has an aria-label and the counter is a live region; the hover shift has no reduced-motion guard. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card carries four hairline-split invoice rows; beneath them a centred line reads Page 3 of 10 with the numbers brighter, flanked by small left and right chevrons.
behaves: Hovering a chevron shifts it a touch and the links point to the previous or next page. The caption is fed by currentPage and totalPages while the rows hold still.
customise: currentPage and totalPages drive the caption and the disabled ends; chevron size, spacing and link styling are fixed in the classes.
weight: light: Two chevron links and a short caption; no loop or heavy script.
demo: Invoice rows INV-2031 to INV-2034 for Acme, Globex, Initech and Umbrella; Page 3 of 10.
polishWhy: Compact centred counter with clear chevrons; tidy but unremarkable.
